posts.title: Checking exposure to the November 2026 PHP security releases
posts.description: PHP 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37 and 8.2.36 were released today as security releases. The pre-announcement said that the issues rated CRITICAL “require either non-default configuration or uncommon setups.” The ChangeLog only lists advisory titles, so I went through all 17 advisories with Claude to see what those configurations are, and whether my servers have them. posts.title: Upgrading to FreeBSD 15
posts.description: Some additional steps were necessary when upgrading to FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE: freebsd-update upgrade -r 15.0-RELEASE freebsd-update install shutdown -r now freebsd-update install rm -rf \ /usr/local/etc/pkg/repos/FreeBSD.conf \ /var/db/pkg/FreeBSD.meta \ /var/db/pkg/repo-FreeBSD.sqlite \ /var/db/pkg/repos/FreeBSD \ /var/db/pkg/repos/FreeBSD-kmods pkg bootstrap -f pkg update pkg upgrade pkg install
